usages.explain: Expresses the meaning "because of a strong desire for something, enduring hardships and even doing things that are undesirable or negative."

examples.content: わずかな金がほしいばかりに、泥棒になるなんて、馬鹿げたことだろう。
examples.transcription: わずかなきんがほしいばかりに、どろぼうになるなんて、ばかげたことだろう。
examples.mean: It would be foolish to become a thief just for a little money.

usages.synopsis: N + が + ほしいばかりに

title: ... ほしいばかりに => just because I want to…
